name: Troy
source:
One of the Triad(or Three Heavenly Kings) as they called. Troy is the calm girl with quite boyish look, who admired [url=/c11424]Ria[/url] a lot in the past but wants to defeat her now. 

[spoiler]She was Ria's apprentice and it's hinted that she had a crush on her.

She died during the fight  in Sect Falcon's palace but was resurrected by Nero.[/spoiler]
